chunks: Abu Malik al-Hadrami narrated from Abu al-'Abbas, who said:
I heard al-Sadiq عليه السلام saying: "The servant, whenever he increases in love for women, increases in faith in excellence."

key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith, belief in its religious sense
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the servant, meaning the human being in relation to Allah
key_terms.فَضْلًا: increase in excellence, virtue, or added merit
key_terms.لِلنِّسَاءِ: for women; referring to affection toward women

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the relationship between love for women and faith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام presents affection for women as connected to the refinement and increase of iman. It frames this quality as a virtuous disposition rather than something opposed to faith.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4350 - Abu Malik al-Hadrami narrated from Abu al-Abbas, who said that he heard Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) say:
"The more love a servant has for women, the greater he increases in faith and virtue."
